item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus gsang ba ye shes chen mo yi gsung sgrub dbyings rig 'od gsal
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gsung sgrab dbyings rig 'od gsal 'di ni/ rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i byang phyogs/ mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs thams cad dus rtag tu sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i gnas mchog ka ke'u seng ge+e yongs rdzong nyi ma rang shar zhes bya ba'ike'u gong du/ yun chen thugs rje byams ma'i snang brten (rten) g.yung drung bde ba'i snga po can ma yis/ rten 'brel legs pa'i sgo 'phar gcig char du 'byed pa'i lde mig mdzad pa nas/ bstan sbyin rtsa grogs las slob skal ldan rnams kyi snying nor du/ gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor chen por gyur pa kun grol grags pa (pas) / mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda yi yi ge gcig la nges pa'i don gyi thig le 'bum du shar bzhin/ dung shog dkar po la g.yu ris sngon po'i yi ger btab cing brtsams pa/ me 'brug hor zla brgyad pa'i 'phel phyogs su dge legs bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur cig
